

```{r, static yield stability by CV and treatment}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cv_by_trt <- D %>%
  filter(treatment %in% 1:18) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(lupin_tha, oat_tha, total_yield_tha),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable, trt, y, l) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_val   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
    cv       = sd_val / (mean_val + 1e-6) * 100,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable, trt) %>%
  summarise(
    env_cv = mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = variable,
    values_from = env_cv
  ) %>%
  rename(
    lupin_tha_cv     = lupin_tha,
    oat_tha_cv       = oat_tha,
    total_yield_cv   = total_yield_tha
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(trt))

print(cv_by_trt)

```

```{r, static yield stability permanova to test for statistical difference lupin and oat}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)         
library(pairwiseAdonis)

#compute CV using mean & SD, then PERMANOVA + pairwise tests
cv_adonis_sd <- function(var_name,
                         data      = D_stability,
                         n_perm    = 999,
                         do_pair   = TRUE) {

  cv_tbl <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(var_name),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(variable, trt, y, l) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_val   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
      cv       = sd_val / (mean_val + 1e-6) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-mean_val, -sd_val) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = variable,
                values_from = cv,
                values_fill = 0) %>%
    drop_na()

  cv_mat <- cv_tbl %>% select(-trt, -y, -l) %>% as.matrix()
  grp    <- cv_tbl %>% select(trt, y, l)

  global <- adonis2(
    cv_mat ~ trt + y + l + trt:y + trt:l + y:l,
    data         = grp,
    permutations = n_perm,
    method       = "euclidean",
    by           = "terms"
  )

  pairwise <- NULL
  if (do_pair) {
    pairwise <- pairwise.adonis2(
      cv_mat ~ trt,
      data         = grp,
      permutations = n_perm,
      method       = "euclidean"
    )
  }

  list(global   = global,
       pairwise = pairwise)
}

# Run for total, lupin and oat yields
res_total <- cv_adonis_sd("total_yield_tha")
res_lupin <- cv_adonis_sd("lupin_tha")
res_oat   <- cv_adonis_sd("oat_tha")

cat("=== Total Yield CV (mean & SD) ===\n")
print(res_total$global)
cat("\nPairwise PERMANOVA (trt):\n")
print(res_total$pairwise)

cat("\n\n=== Lupin Yield CV ===\n")
print(res_lupin$global)
cat("\nPairwise PERMANOVA (trt):\n")
print(res_lupin$pairwise)

cat("\n\n=== Oat Yield CV ===\n")
print(res_oat$global)
cat("\nPairwise PERMANOVA (trt):\n")
print(res_oat$pairwise)


```


```{r, static yield pairwise permanova}
#install.packages("remotes")
#remotes::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis")
library(pairwiseAdonis)


cv_median_data <- D_stability %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(total_yield_tha),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable, trt, y, l, cv_lupin, cv_oat_N) %>%
  summarise(
    median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mad_value    = mad(value, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_median    = mad_value / (median_value + 1e-6) * 100,
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

cv_median_wide <- cv_median_data %>%
  select(-median_value, -mad_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = variable,
    values_from = cv_median,
    values_fill = 0
  )

cv_matrix         <- cv_median_wide %>% select(total_yield_tha) %>% as.matrix()
grouping_factors  <- cv_median_wide %>% select(trt, cv_lupin, cv_oat_N)

pairwise_trt <- pairwise.adonis2(
  cv_matrix ~ trt,
  data         = grouping_factors,
  permutations = 999,
  method       = "euclidean"
)
cat("\nPairwise PERMANOVA results for trt:\n")
print(pairwise_trt)

```

## Dynamic stability based on the AMMI-Models
```{r, ammi model to re-verify b1 value}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
GE <- D_stability %>%
  filter( !is.na(total_yield_tha) ) %>% 
  group_by(l, trt) %>%
  summarise(mean_y = mean(total_yield_tha), .groups = "drop")

env_index <- GE %>% group_by(l) %>% summarise(I_e = mean(mean_y) - mean(GE$mean_y))
GE <- GE %>% left_join(env_index, by = "l")

fw_results <- GE %>%
  nest(data = -trt) %>%
  mutate(
    fit  = map(data, ~ lm(mean_y ~ I_e, data = .x)),
    b1   = map_dbl(fit, ~ coef(.x)[2]),
    se_b = map_dbl(fit, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients[2,2]),
    t_b1 = map_dbl(fit, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients[2,3]),
    p_b1 = map_dbl(fit, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients[2,4]),
    s2di = map_dbl(fit, ~ mean(residuals(.x)^2))
  ) %>%
  select(trt, b1, se_b, t_b1, p_b1, s2di)

print(fw_results, digits = 3)


```

```{r, waas model metan}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(metan)

D_core <- D %>%
  select(l, trt, total_yield_tha) %>%
  filter(!is.na(l), !is.na(trt), !is.na(total_yield_tha)) %>%
  mutate(l   = factor(l),
         trt = factor(trt))

D_bal <- D_core %>%
  complete(l, trt, fill = list(total_yield_tha = NA)) %>%
  group_by(l) %>% 
  mutate(total_yield_tha = ifelse(
           is.na(total_yield_tha),
           mean(total_yield_tha, na.rm = TRUE),
           total_yield_tha)
  ) %>% ungroup()

D_bal <- D_bal %>%
  mutate(block_ID = factor(rep(1:2, length.out = n())))


AMMI_model <- waas(
  D_bal, 
  l, trt, block_ID,
  total_yield_tha,
  verbose = FALSE
)
options(tibble.print_max = Inf, tibble.width = Inf)
print(AMMI_model, digits = 2)

```

```{r, waas scores sign difference by helper model}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

#fit AMMI‐style mixed model (genotype × environment)
mod_ammi <- lmer(
  total_yield_tha ~ 
    trt    +
    l      + 
    (1 | trt:l) +
    (1 | l:block_ID),
  data = D_bal
)

#emmeans across all environments
emm_trt <- emmeans(mod_ammi, ~ trt)
print(emm_trt)

#Tukey‐adjusted pairwise comparisons
pairs(emm_trt, adjust = "tukey") |> print()

emm_trt_by_env <- emmeans(mod_ammi, ~ trt | l)

print(emm_trt_by_env)
pairs(emm_trt_by_env, adjust = "tukey") |> print()

```

# Yield stability graphs

```{r, yield stability graphs no metan}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

#build complete GE-mean matrix
ge_means <- D_bal %>%
  group_by(l, trt) %>%
  summarise(y = mean(total_yield_tha), .groups = "drop")

Ymat <- ge_means %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = l, values_from = y) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("trt") %>% 
  as.matrix()

#AMMI decomposition & WAAS (Olivoto et al. 2019)
grand <- mean(Ymat)
g_eff <- rowMeans(Ymat) - grand
e_eff <- colMeans(Ymat) - grand
Int   <- Ymat - grand -
        matrix(g_eff, nrow = nrow(Ymat), ncol = ncol(Ymat), byrow = FALSE) -
        matrix(e_eff, nrow = nrow(Ymat), ncol = ncol(Ymat), byrow = TRUE)

sv  <- svd(Int)                                        
w   <- (sv$d^2) / sum(sv$d^2)
Gsc <- sv$u %*% diag(sv$d)
Esc <- sv$v %*% diag(sv$d)
WAAS <- c(0.66, 0.58, 0.8, 0.35, 0.08, 0.15, 0.44, 0.48, 0.38, 0.11, 0.04, 0.08, 0.21, 0.34, 0.1, 0.2, 0.35, 0.067)#rowSums(abs(Gsc) %*% diag(w))

plot_env <- data.frame(
  env = colnames(Ymat),
  PC1 = Esc[, 1],
  PC2 = Esc[, 2]
)

plot_gen <- data.frame(
  trt  = rownames(Ymat),
  Y    = rowMeans(Ymat),
  WAAS = WAAS,
  PC1  = Gsc[, 1],
  PC2  = Gsc[, 2]
)

trt_labels <- data.frame(
  trt   = as.character(1:18),
  label = c(
    "Bison", "Lion", "Troll", "Bison_N", "Lion_N", "Troll_N",
    "Lunabor", "Probor", "Jowisz",
    "Bison x Lunabor", "Bison x Probor", "Bison x Jowisz",
    "Lion x Lunabor",  "Lion x Probor",  "Lion x Jowisz",
    "Troll x Lunabor", "Troll x Probor", "Troll x Jowisz"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

plot_gen <- plot_gen %>% 
  mutate(trt = as.character(trt)) %>%
  left_join(trt_labels, by = "trt")


plot_gen2 <- plot_gen %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    stand = dplyr::case_when(
      trt %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")    ~ "Oat",
      trt %in% c("7","8","9")    ~ "Lupin",
      TRUE                      ~ "Mixed"
    )
  )

#choose your three colours
cols <- c(
  Oat   = "forestgreen",
  Lupin = "purple",
  Mixed = "dodgerblue"
)

#Yield × WAAS scatter
yieldxwaas <- ggplot(plot_gen2, aes(WAAS, Y, label = label, colour = stand)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(plot_gen2$Y),    linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(plot_gen2$WAAS), linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(min.segment.length = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Crop", values = cols) +
  labs(
    x = "Environmental sensitivity (WAAS)",
    y = expression(Mean~total~yield~(t~ha^{-1}))
  ) +
  theme_bw()

#AMMI PC1 × PC2 biplo
ammibiplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(data = plot_gen2,
             aes(PC1, PC2, colour = stand),
             size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = plot_gen2,
                  aes(PC1, PC2, label = label, colour = stand),
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_point(data = plot_env,
             aes(PC1, PC2),
             colour = "darkred", shape = 17, size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = plot_env,
                  aes(PC1, PC2, label = env),
                  colour = "darkred",
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Crop", values = cols) +
  labs(x = "IPCA-1", y = "IPCA-2") +
  theme_bw()

#save()
ggsave("writing/pictures/yieldxwaas.png", yieldxwaas, dpi=600, w=6, h=5, units="in")
ggsave("writing/pictures/ammibiplot.png", ammibiplot, dpi=600, w=6, h=5, units="in")

```

# yield overview graph
```{r, yield overview plot}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#the five locations in your D
locations <- unique(D$l)

plots <- lapply(locations, function(loc){

  #filter by treatment *and* this location
  D_filtered <- D %>%
    filter(treatment %in% 1:18, l == loc) %>%
    mutate(treatment = as.numeric(as.character(treatment)))

  #assign x‐variety label
  D_filtered <- D_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      x_label = case_when(
        treatment %in% 1:3   ~ as.character(cv_oat_N),
        treatment %in% 4:6   ~ as.character(cv_oat_N),
        treatment %in% 7:9   ~ as.character(cv_lupin),
        treatment %in% 10:18 ~ paste(cv_oat, "×", cv_lupin)
      )
    )

  #median & MAD
  D_summary <- D_filtered %>%
    group_by(treatment, x_label, cv_oat_N, cv_lupin) %>%
    summarise(
      oat_yield_median   = median(oat_tha,    na.rm = TRUE),
      oat_yield_mad      = mad(oat_tha, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      lupin_yield_median = median(lupin_tha,  na.rm = TRUE),
      lupin_yield_mad    = mad(lupin_tha, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = c(oat_yield_median, lupin_yield_median), 
      names_to  = "crop", 
      values_to = "yield"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      mad  = ifelse(crop == "oat_yield_median", oat_yield_mad, lupin_yield_mad),
      crop = recode(crop,
                    oat_yield_median   = "Oat Yield",
                    lupin_yield_median = "Lupin Yield")
    ) %>%
    drop_na(yield, mad)

  #error‐bar positions
  D_summary <- D_summary %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    mutate(
      lupin_yield   = ifelse(crop == "Lupin Yield", yield, 0),
      oat_yield     = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield",   yield, 0),
      stacked_yield = sum(yield, na.rm = TRUE),

      errorbar_min = ifelse(crop == "Lupin Yield",
                            yield - mad, yield),
      errorbar_max = ifelse(crop == "Lupin Yield",
                            yield + mad, yield),

      errorbar_min = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment >= 10,
                            stacked_yield - mad,
                            errorbar_min),
      errorbar_max = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment >= 10,
                            stacked_yield + mad,
                            errorbar_max),

      errorbar_min = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment < 7,
                            oat_yield - mad,
                            errorbar_min),
      errorbar_max = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment < 7,
                            oat_yield + mad,
                            errorbar_max)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      errorbar_min = ifelse(is.na(errorbar_min), yield - mad, errorbar_min),
      errorbar_max = ifelse(is.na(errorbar_max), yield + mad, errorbar_max)
    ) %>%
    arrange(treatment, crop) %>%
    mutate(
      fill_color = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield",
                          as.character(cv_oat_N),
                          as.character(cv_lupin))
    )

  #colors & factor levels
  oat_colors   <- c("Bison"="#117733","Lion"="#44AA99","Troll"="#88CCEE", "Bison_N"="#D4A017","Lion_N"="#C68642","Troll_N"="#8B6B3E")
  lupin_colors <- c("Jowisz"="#CC6677","Lunabor"="#882255","Probor"="#AA4499")
  palette      <- c(oat_colors, lupin_colors)
  D_summary$fill_color <- factor(
    D_summary$fill_color,
    levels = c("Bison","Lion","Troll","Bison_N","Lion_N","Troll_N","Lunabor","Probor","Jowisz")
  )

  ggplot(D_summary,
         aes(x = factor(x_label, levels = unique(x_label)),
             y = yield,
             fill = fill_color)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack", width=0.7, color="black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = errorbar_min, ymax = errorbar_max, group = crop),
                  width = 0.3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette,
                      guide = guide_legend(title = "Variety",
                                           override.aes = list(size=6))) +
    labs(
      title = loc,
      x = "Variety combination",
      y = expression("Yield ("*t~ha^{-1}*")"),
      fill = "Variety"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title     = element_text(size=15, hjust=0),
      axis.text.x    = element_text(size=11, angle=45, hjust=1),
      axis.text.y    = element_text(size=11),
      axis.title.x   = element_text(size=13),
      axis.title.y   = element_text(size=13),
      legend.text    = element_text(size=11),
      legend.title   = element_text(size=13),
      legend.key.size= unit(1.2, "lines")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 6.3)) 
})
```

```{r all yield plots cominbed}
library(patchwork)


p1 <- plots[["Gross"]]
p2 <- plots[["Novi"]]

p5 <- plots[["Vilbel"]]

p1 <- p1 +
  labs(title = "Gross Lüsewitz (DE)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
    legend.position = "right"

p2 <- p2 +
  labs(title = "Novi Sad (RS)") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),

  )

p3 <- p3 +
  labs(title = "Reckenholz (CH)") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),

  )

p4 <- p4 +
  labs(title = "Seegräben (CH)") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line()
  )

p5 <- p5 +
  labs(title = "Bad Vilbel (DE)") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(

# save
```

```{r, all yield summarised across locations plot}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

D_all <- D %>%
  filter(treatment %in% 1:18) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = as.numeric(as.character(treatment)),
    # x-label per your rules
    x_label = case_when(
      treatment %in% 1:3   ~ as.character(cv_oat_N),
      treatment %in% 4:6   ~ as.character(cv_oat_N),
      treatment %in% 7:9   ~ as.character(cv_lupin),
      treatment %in% 10:18 ~ paste(cv_oat, "×", cv_lupin)
    )
  )

D_summary <- D_all %>%
  group_by(treatment, x_label, cv_oat_N, cv_lupin) %>%
  summarise(
    oat_yield_median   = median(oat_tha,   na.rm = TRUE),
    oat_yield_mad      = mad(oat_tha,      constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    lupin_yield_median = median(lupin_tha, na.rm = TRUE),
    lupin_yield_mad    = mad(lupin_tha,    constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(oat_yield_median, lupin_yield_median),
    names_to  = "crop",
    values_to = "yield"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mad  = ifelse(crop == "oat_yield_median", oat_yield_mad, lupin_yield_mad),
    crop = recode(crop,
                  oat_yield_median   = "Oat Yield",
                  lupin_yield_median = "Lupin Yield")
  ) %>%
  drop_na(yield, mad)

D_summary <- D_summary %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    lupin_yield   = ifelse(crop == "Lupin Yield", yield, 0),
    oat_yield     = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield",   yield, 0),
    stacked_yield = sum(yield, na.rm = TRUE),

    errorbar_min = ifelse(crop == "Lupin Yield", yield - mad, yield),
    errorbar_max = ifelse(crop == "Lupin Yield", yield + mad, yield),

    # stacked error for Oat in mixtures (treatment >= 10)
    errorbar_min = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment >= 10,
                          stacked_yield - mad, errorbar_min),
    errorbar_max = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment >= 10,
                          stacked_yield + mad, errorbar_max),

    # standalone error for Oat in oat monocultures (treatment < 7)
    errorbar_min = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment < 7,
                          oat_yield - mad, errorbar_min),
    errorbar_max = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield" & treatment < 7,
                          oat_yield + mad, errorbar_max)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    errorbar_min = ifelse(is.na(errorbar_min), yield - mad, errorbar_min),
    errorbar_max = ifelse(is.na(errorbar_max), yield + mad, errorbar_max)
  ) %>%
  arrange(treatment, crop) %>%
  mutate(
    fill_color = ifelse(crop == "Oat Yield",
                        as.character(cv_oat_N),
                        as.character(cv_lupin))
  )

oat_colors   <- c("Bison"="#117733","Lion"="#44AA99","Troll"="#88CCEE",
                  "Bison_N"="#D4A017","Lion_N"="#C68642","Troll_N"="#8B6B3E")
lupin_colors <- c("Jowisz"="#CC6677","Lunabor"="#882255","Probor"="#AA4499")
palette      <- c(oat_colors, lupin_colors)

D_summary$fill_color <- factor(
  D_summary$fill_color,
  levels = c("Bison","Lion","Troll","Bison_N","Lion_N","Troll_N","Lunabor","Probor","Jowisz")
)

x_levels <- D_summary %>% arrange(treatment) %>% pull(x_label) %>% unique()
D_summary <- D_summary %>% mutate(x_label = factor(x_label, levels = x_levels))

p_all_locations <- ggplot(
  D_summary,
  aes(x = x_label, y = yield, fill = fill_color)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = errorbar_min, ymax = errorbar_max, group = crop),
                width = 0.3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette,
                    guide = guide_legend(title = "Variety",
                                         override.aes = list(size = 6))) +
  labs(
    x   = "Variety combination",
    y   = expression("Yield ("*t~ha^{-1}*")"),
    fill= "Variety"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

p_all_locations

# Optional: save
ggsave("writing/pictures/allsites.png",
       p_all_locations,
       dpi    = 600,
       width  = 8.27,
       height = 3,
       units  = "in")
```

```{r yield overview as table}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

trt_labels <- tribble(
  ~treatment, ~Treatment,
   1, "Bison",
   2, "Lion",
   3, "Troll",
   4, "Bison_N",
   5, "Lion_N",
   6, "Troll_N",
   7, "Lunabor",
   8, "Probor",
   9, "Jowisz",
  10, "Bison × Lunabor",
  11, "Bison × Probor",
  12, "Bison × Jowisz",
  13, "Lion × Lunabor",
  14, "Lion × Probor",
  15, "Lion × Jowisz",
  16, "Troll × Lunabor",
  17, "Troll × Probor",
  18, "Troll × Jowisz"
) %>% mutate(treatment = as.character(treatment))

treat_order <- trt_labels$Treatment

D_prepped <- D %>%
  mutate(
    treatment        = as.character(treatment),
    total_yield_tha  = coalesce(total_yield_tha, oat_tha + lupin_tha),
    `Location × Year` = paste(l, y)
  ) %>%
  left_join(trt_labels, by = "treatment")

summ_long <- D_prepped %>%
  group_by(`Location × Year`, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(total_yield_tha, na.rm = TRUE),
    mad = mad(total_yield_tha, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Median ± MAD` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", med, mad)) %>%
  select(`Location × Year`, Treatment, `Median ± MAD`)

yield_table <- summ_long %>%
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treat_order)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = `Location × Year`,
    values_from = `Median ± MAD`,
    values_fn   = list(`Median ± MAD` = dplyr::first)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(Treatment = as.character(Treatment)) %>%
  #replace NA cells with empty string
  mutate(across(-Treatment, ~ tidyr::replace_na(., "")))

yield_table

write.csv(yield_table, "writing/yield_table.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

```{r, total yield differences pure to mixed}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(tidyr)

cmp <- D %>%
  filter(treatment %in% 4:18,
         !is.na(total_yield_tha),
         !is.na(y)) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(treatment %in% 4:9, "Pure", "Mixed"))

desc <- cmp %>%
  group_by(l, y, group) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(total_yield_tha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = group,
              values_from = mean_yield,
              names_prefix = "mean_")

tt <- cmp %>%
  group_by(l, y) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(total_yield_tha ~ group, data = .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    l,
    y,
    estimate_pure  = estimate1,
    estimate_mixed = estimate2,
    diff_estimate  = estimate,
    t_value        = statistic,
    df             = parameter,
    p_value        = p.value,
    conf_low       = conf.low,
    conf_high      = conf.high
  )

result <- left_join(desc, tt, by = c("l", "y"))

print(result, n = Inf, width = Inf, digits = 3)


```

```{r, cpr differences N no n}

library(dplyr)
library(broom)

df <- D %>%
  filter(treatment %in% 10:18) %>%
  select(treatment, CPR, CPR_N) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(CPR, CPR_N)

res_ttest <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n               = n(),
    mean_CPR        = mean(CPR),
    mean_CPR_N      = mean(CPR_N),
    mean_diff       = mean(CPR - CPR_N),
    sd_diff         = sd(CPR - CPR_N),
 
    cohen_dz        = mean_diff / sd_diff,
    ttest = list(t.test(CPR, CPR_N, paired = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(ttest = purrr::map(ttest, broom::tidy)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(ttest) %>%
  transmute(
    treatment, n, mean_CPR, mean_CPR_N, mean_diff, cohen_dz,
    conf.low, conf.high, statistic, p.value,
    p.value_FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    method
  )

print(res_ttest, n = Inf)

res_wilcox <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n           = n(),
    mean_diff   = mean(CPR - CPR_N),
    wilcox = list(wilcox.test(CPR, CPR_N, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(wilcox = purrr::map(wilcox, broom::tidy)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(wilcox) %>%
  transmute(
    treatment, n, mean_diff,
    p.value,
    p.value_FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    method
  )

print(res_wilcox, n = Inf)
```
